title: EventEnvelope
description: TASK-0142, resolving implementation-task-backlog.md §8's own ITQ-2. Transcribes shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/kencric/scoring/core/model/AuditedEvent.kt field-for-field, minus `event` itself (that field's shape is each per-event schema's own `allOf` partner, per live-scoring.md §17: 'every event in §16 IS its own audit record -- there is no separate audit-log write'). Mirrors match_events' own columns (TASK-0006/0007) so the JSON Schema, the persisted shape, and the Kotlin shape all agree field-for-field -- nothing invented here, only transcribed.

schema_version.description: system-architecture.md §4.8: additive-only evolution. v1 here; a v2.schema.json sibling file is added, never a breaking edit to v1.

provenance.description: live-scoring.md §16.2/§17.2 -- captured at write time, never reconstructed later, which is why every field here is required.

serverReceivedAt.description: Epoch millis; null until the server has ingested this event.

prevHash.description: HONEST GAP, carried over from AuditedEvent.kt's own doc comment: no canonical serialisation format for a MatchEvent has been chosen anywhere in this backlog, so this field's own producing algorithm is not specified here either -- the shape is fixed, the computation is not.

supersedes.description: Set iff this event is a correction superseding an earlier one (§14).
